style.vernacular: One of the densest cities on earth, packed onto a roughly 2 km island of reclaimed land. Ordinary buildings are 4-8 storey concrete apartment and office blocks in painted render (white, cream, pale blue, yellow, terracotta), flat roofs crowded with water tanks, solar panels and satellite dishes, narrow asphalt lanes and almost no gaps between plots.
